exp.thm-main.markdown:
**Theorem 1.** *Let $n_1<n_2<\dots$ be an infinite sequence of positive integers. If $\sum_{k=1}^{\infty}1/n_k<\infty$, then*
$$
\sum_{k=1}^{\infty}\frac1{2^{n_k}-1}
$$
*is irrational.*
